title: podocarpus macrophyllus subsp. piliramulus
intro: Podocarpus macrophyllus subsp. piliramulus, commonly known as the Japanese yew or mountain plum pine, is a plant species belonging to the Podocarpaceae family. The plant is valued for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Podocarpus macrophyllus subsp. piliramulus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. These compounds have been found to exhibit potential therapeutic applications in traditional medicine, particularly in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues.
